faqs.a:
Section 108.1.4. Unlawful structure,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
108.1.4. Unlawful structure.
An unlawful structure is one found in whole or in part to be occupied by more persons
                  than permitted under the land development code, or was erected, altered or occupied
                  contrary to law."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
